operational.name: Strength 5x5
operational.description: Squat, bench, row, press and deadlift five sets of five, with the next weight worked out for you.

demo.name: Strength 5x5
demo.description: Demo: five weeks of synthetic 5x5 sessions, a deload and Apple Health workouts, read-only.

presentation.outcome: Get stronger every session with a simple 5x5 barbell program.
connectors: Apple Health · your own import: strength workouts and body mass, read only
steps: The empty 20 kg bar for most lifts and 40 kg for the deadlift, or your own.
A is squat, bench press and barbell row; B is squat, overhead press and deadlift. Three sessions a week suits most people.
At the gym, tap a set for five reps or tap again for fewer, then save the session.
Every set of five adds 2.5 kg next time (5 kg on the deadlift); three failed sessions in a row take 10% off.
Sync to see each session's duration, energy and heart rate, and your bodyweight trend.
presentation.access: Your own app: only you log sessions, set weights and sync. It reads your strength workouts and body mass through your Apple Health grant and never changes Health data; it works without one. Demo data is synthetic and read-only.
